usage.notes: Treat Z-Anatomy as an asset-acquisition/build-time source. Runtime delivery should use Panacea-controlled optimized derivatives with their own asset manifest and preserved attribution/license metadata.

license.scope: The Z-Anatomy repository states that its shared code/content is CC BY-SA 4.0, while its license/attribution file also identifies incorporated or referenced models under licenses including CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0. Therefore every imported anatomical asset must carry its own provenance and license decision before commercial use.
license.notes: Never infer commercial permission from the repository-level license alone. Block production ingestion when the selected asset has no explicit asset-level license/provenance record.

validation.notes: Use as anatomical visualization/reference material. Do not present geometry alone as patient-specific anatomy, diagnostic evidence, or validated procedural guidance.

provenance.authority: Z-Anatomy project with documented upstream model attributions including BodyParts3D and other contributors
provenance.notes: Record upstream creator/source, exact asset identifier, source revision, transformation history and attribution text for every derived Panacea mesh.

adapter.notes: Planned pipeline: source asset -> license/provenance gate -> mesh cleanup -> stable anatomical ID mapping -> LOD/compression -> GLB/glTF -> Panacea anatomy renderer.
